criteria_results.text: An exact-owner projectless desktop human chat discovered in mobile Chats can be opened and its transcript can be read without treating it as missing from the selected project.
criteria_results.notes: The physical iPhone opened and rendered the desktop transcript, then returned to Opening chat.

criteria_results.text: Opening a chat becomes ready after its bounded message page loads; diff, todos, permissions, and questions refresh afterward and cannot hold the opening screen hostage.
criteria_results.notes: The opener reached ready, but an older in-flight active-session bootstrap completed afterward and restored the remembered scoped project session.

criteria_results.text: Once the opener reaches ready for the requested chat, a transient render before provider selection state commits must not cancel or reopen it; the transcript remains stable without flashing back to Opening chat.
criteria_results.notes: The c14 fix prevented the route's cancel/reopen race, but its component-level contract did not cover later provider selection displacement by background bootstrap.

criteria_results.text: After an exact-owner projectless chat reaches ready, a background scoped project session refresh or older in-flight active-session bootstrap must not evict it or restore a previously remembered project chat; the opened transcript remains current until explicit navigation.
criteria_results.notes: Attached Metro tracing reproduced currentSessionId moving from the real owner-opened ses_045dc… to remembered scoped ses_045b… while openKind remained ready.

process_issues.description: The prior corrective commit was pushed and handed to physical smoke without waiting for its GitHub Actions run to complete.
process_issues.detected_by: Transcript review shows git push followed directly by device relaunch; no gh run watch --exit-status occurred between them.

failure_output: fail. opening chat, chat showed, then went back to Opening chat. Live trace: ready/current ses_045dc… then ready/current ses_045b….
suggested_follow_up: Drive the real provider lifecycle through concurrent owner-open and active-session bootstrap completion, and assert there is no intermediate session-ID displacement before physical smoke.
